repos_data.description: Free, open-source notch app for MacBook: turns the Mac notch into a Dynamic Island-style live status area with now playing, a focus timer, your next meeting with a camera mirror, weather, notes, Keep Awake (lid closed too), AirPods battery and a volume and brightness HUD. macOS 26+. Your MacBook's notch, put to work.
Zsh plugin that displays your airpods battery level in prompt
